title: Using the AI Assistant
excerpt: Master Kahana's AI Assistant to enhance your browsing experience with natural language commands.
content:
Getting Started with AI Assistant

The AI Assistant is your intelligent companion in Kahana Browser. Here's how to make the most of it:

Basic Commands

Try these common commands:

  • "Open my email"
  • "Search for project documentation"
  • "Create a new Hub for marketing"
  • "Summarize this page"

Advanced Features

Explore these advanced capabilities:

  • Natural language search across your Hubs
  • Smart content organization
  • Automated task completion
  • Context-aware suggestions
